values.note: 2026: $12/night for a standard non-electric site in every season (group loops $75). Fee covers two vehicles and one wheeled camping unit; $5 per extra vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232126/rates (2026 Non-Peak, Peak and First-come First-served seasons: 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC': 12, 'GROUP STANDARD NONELECTRIC': 75) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232126 (notice: 'Fee includes two vehicles and one wheeled camping unit; a $5/vehicle fee will be collected for extra vehicles'), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232126 (every family site typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-20

values.note: The catalog lists 54 standard non-electric family sites (35 reservable, 19 first-come) plus reservable group loops; the description says 'over 70' sites. Max vehicle lengths 25-60 ft, all back-in. Each site has a picnic table, fire ring and tent pad.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232126 (site types, reservable flag, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232126 ('Over 70 spacious, shaded campsites are available, each containing a picnic table, campfire ring, and tent pad'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Hand-pumped water only in loop E. recreation.gov: 'The dump station at Tracy Ridge is closed.'

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232126 ('Vault toilets are also available. Hand-pumped water is only available in loop E'; notice 'The dump station at Tracy Ridge is closed.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov; some sites are always first-come, and the 2026 rate table runs a first-come, first-served season from September 9 to December 16. Weekend reservations 2 nights, holiday weekends 3. 14 nights in any 30. Check-out noon; fees paid by 2 pm by envelope.

Camping fees must be paid by 2:00 pm') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232126/rates ('First-come, First-served Season 2026-09-09 2026-12-16'), read 2026-10-20

note: Allegheny NF ridge-top campground, a base for the Tracy Ridge trail system about 5 miles above the Allegheny Reservoir; concession-run (Allegheny Site Management). Reservable online in summer, with some first-come sites and a first-come fall season; no hookups, vault toilets, hand-pump water in loop E; the dump station is closed (2026). Back-in sites fit RVs ~25-60 ft. Not on the water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $12 (2026), no electric, 60-ft max (all back-in), reservable on recreation.gov. Changed fcfs after_cutoff -> some_sites; cleared dump (rec.gov: the dump station is closed). Added 54 catalog family sites, vault toilets, hand-pump water, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night limit. Note corrected (dump closed). Not stated: booking window, a campground season statement.
flags: Entry phone is empty. recreation.gov gives 814-368-4158 (Allegheny Site Management, the concessionaire).

Season: the entry's derived closes 09-19 (from the availability calendar) looks like the end of the reservable season; the 2026 rate table runs a First-come, First-served Season from 2026-09-09 to 2026-12-16, so the campground likely stays open first-come into December. A rate season is not a campground season, so it was not written.
